requirement_statement: EAIF normative statements SHOULD preserve explicit authority, maturity and source-evidence references.
verification_evidence: Requirement row contains authority, maturity and resolvable evidence references.
implementation_notes: Applies to the normalized requirements corpus and generated outputs.

requirement_statement: EAIF outputs SHOULD clearly distinguish working interpretation and meeting intelligence from approved policy or architecture decisions.
verification_evidence: Generated draft retains source-status labels and review notes.
implementation_notes: Do not resolve uncertainty by wording alone.

requirement_statement: Data readiness SHOULD be assessed as an upstream architecture concern for AI-enabled initiatives.
verification_evidence: Assessment records data ownership, stewardship, classification, quality, lineage and migration/data-flow considerations as applicable.
implementation_notes: Specific controls remain workload- and data-classification dependent.

requirement_statement: PATH and HAIL role definitions SHOULD remain explicitly classified as working architecture positions until approved evidence establishes target-state responsibilities.
verification_evidence: Target-state material labels PATH/HAIL assertions by authority and maturity.
implementation_notes: Convergence must not be assumed to mean physical consolidation.

requirement_statement: Purview SHOULD be treated as a data-governance/control-plane capability only to the extent supported by registered evidence and implementation coverage.
verification_evidence: Architecture material identifies covered controls, integration boundaries and gaps.
implementation_notes: Avoid statements implying blanket compliance or universal coverage.

requirement_statement: AI initiatives SHOULD undergo governance triage early enough to identify applicable DADM/AIA and related obligations before production authorization.
verification_evidence: Lifecycle record shows governance screening and applicable follow-up evidence.
implementation_notes: Validate final wording against current TBS policy before publication.

requirement_statement: Generated EAIF documents SHOULD remain derivative outputs while normalized evidence and requirements remain the traceable drafting inputs.
verification_evidence: Generated artifact can be recreated from version-controlled inputs and PR history.
implementation_notes: SACR remains the record repository for stable/approved documents.
